task_description_cache:
Matched Task: I./3. Transitions in training box I.

Minimum required FI rating: FI(R) PPL(A) endorsement, VFR privilige

Pre-flight briefing
✓ Effect of flight controls
✓ Horizon attitudes
✓ Transition between flight attitudes
✓ Traffic Pattern
✓ Low pass
✓ Landing vs. Go Around
✓ Operation of flaps (in stages):
    - air speed below Vfe;
    - effect on pitch attitude;
    - effect on air speed.
✓ the forces
✓ glide descent: angle, air speed and rate of descent
✓ effect of flaps
✓ effect of wind
✓ effect of mass
✓ engine considerations
✓ power assisted descent: power or air speed and rate of descent
✓ cruise descent
✓ sideslip
✓ use of controls
✓ use of power
✓ maintenance of attitude and balance

Flight lesson
✓ Visual traffic circuit(s)
✓ Level flight
✓ Climb
✓ Descent
✓ Turns (level, climb, descent all task is commenced with 360° heading difference)
✓ Transitions
✓ Climbing turns
✓ Descending turns
✓ Turns to selected headings: use of gyro heading indicator and magnetic compass
✓ Use of instruments to achieve precision flight
✓ Maintenance of attitude and balance;
Optional:
✓ Traffic Pattern

In addition to providing a review of manoeuvres previously presented, the student will be introduced to different climb and descent configurations and how to transition from one to the other.
Students will continue to demonstrate a solid understanding of the basic aircraft attitudes. During this flight the student will practice various types of climbing and descending while maintaining the desired aircraft performance required for practical flying and flying straight and level using various speeds and A/C configurations.
The student can practice traffic pattern after leaving the traing box. (Optional)
